consequence.statement: New optional capability; the evidence states no operational consequence for existing setups.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for remote cluster authentication using Workload Identity for Kustomization and HelmRelease.

decision.reason: [ev-18f64e30ab1c] lists this item under "Overview of the new features" and describes it as added "Support for" Workload Identity authentication to remote clusters in Kustomization and HelmRelease. That reads as a new capability you opt into. Nothing in the evidence says that existing setups fail, are rejected, stop being honoured or must be migrated, so if you do nothing, nothing happens. That makes "none" (informational) the right fit, not an action-eligible kind. My confidence is low because the one-line highlight doesn't explicitly say that existing configurations are unaffected.
